page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: rentur: omnes à vi & factis sibi tempera-rent: controversias suas, & hanc captivita-tis, fugę, motorum armorum, aliarum injuriarum aut criminum causam judicio a-quo & legitimo, quale in conventione priore descriptum, permitterent: dein cætera omnia eådem conventione comprehensa haberent ra-ta, & sine vitio servarent. Entenius, & cæteri è custodia dimittendi obligarent se, judicio se staturos, & judicato satisfactu-ros.Nota. Oppidanis restituretur possessio juris prioris sine defectu & sine morâ, in quâ turbati ab agrariis erant, eaque iisdem maneret ad latam usque sententiam: Similiter agrarii ab oppidanis restituerentur in integrum in rebus unde controversiæ hujus causa erant dejecti. Præses Rennebergius, & reliqui ejus vicinæ præfecti inferiores, viderent, curarentque diligenter, ne quid contra decretum hoc à quoquam committeretur, committentesque ne ferrent impune. Signatum Antwerpiæ die xxiii Octobr. anno eodem M. D. LXXVIII. Nec diu post reversis jam secundo ad suos legatis dimissi captivi reliqui. Sed occultis consiliis Rennebergii Hispanicas par-

page.notes: The year "LXXVIII" and the day "xxiii" are read from a tight scan and are uncertain; the year may be LXXVIII (1578). The word "tes" below the last line is treated as the catchword and the text ends on "par-". The small dots and marks in both margins are printer's ornaments or stray marks, not text. The Google watermark at the lower right is a digitiser banner and is left out. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
